title: Strip mall world?
content: Just came across this sub, fascinating topic! While mine have never taken place in an indoor mall, I do have a few "recurring environments" to my dreams that are not real life places on earth but look pretty consistent from dream to dream. One of the places is a futuristic gambling town (think Meet the Robinsons for general idea of motif) that I call "Ultra Vegas", one is a parallel Manhattan that has some suburban streets packed in the middle of the chaos, and another is a weird rundown-ish, I guess, little section of a more suburban, almost rural town, including a few blocks of residential homes, and then a road that leads to this rundown strip mall after you go through this overpass tunnel. The strip mall is not very large, maybe half a dozen small 1-story businesses, including a Mexican restaurant, a clothing store, fast food place that seems like an Arby's/Carl's Jr sorry hybrid (I haven't eaten at either in decades), a closed down barber shop, a costume store, and a liquor store. The parking lot is also rundown and could use a good repaving, and the ship signs look like they haven't been updated since the 70s or 80s. I've eaten at the Mexican restaurant, his from someone chasing me down the road by pulling off into the strip mall and hiding in the Mexican restaurant, used the drive thru of the fast food place on my way to Ultra Vegas, and been a person in distress pacing the parking lot and yelling into the closed businesses trying to find a lost family member (either sibling or offspring, wasn't clear in dream). What astounds me about this whole thing is how consistently my mind remembers the details and layout of places I've never actually been to (or that to my knowledge doesn't even exist). Even though I can never figure out for myself that I'm in a dream, I do "recognize" these recurring, imaginary places and in later dreams, even remember the feeling of "knowing the lay of the land" and being able to navigate on imagined roads, highways, sidewalks, and travel tubes (Ultra Vegas and parallel Manhattan) to get to a destination. Anyone have similar experience with recurring, imaginary locations in your dreams that you've dreamt in so many times that you kinda are familiar with it?
